gate_status.promotion_boundary: Generated evidence may close, park, or reopen exploration candidates. It may not promote a route, authorize exact-target work, or make a public complexity claim without a dated decision-substrate change.

ecdlp_research.objective: Reduce uncertainty about the plain single-target secp256k1 ECDLP boundary without changing the threat model.

keyai_product.objective: Validate whether external formal-research teams need and can use the KeyAI control plane.

anti_conflation_rules: Product traffic, site work, pilots, and portability rehearsals never count as ECDLP progress.
Lean theorem volume never counts as cryptanalytic progress without a route-level uncertainty it resolves.
Toy measurements never count as secp256k1 progress without a mechanism and scaling bridge.
ECDLP experiments never count as product validation.

method.claim: The current admissibility gates reject reopening four retained historical cases without a materially new premise, while binding each case to its actual outcome event.
method.limitation: Historical runs predate preregistered priors and likelihoods. They test false reopening only and are excluded from predictive calibration; calibration starts with the first native Engine outcome.

calibration.note: Historical migrations are excluded because their priors and likelihoods were not frozen before observation.

normalized_hypotheses.rationale: The existing control plane is accepted; Research Engine v0 extends rather than replaces it.

normalized_hypotheses.verifier_scope: P0-P4 retain scoped historical measurements. The new finite certificate independently replays the coordinatewise-cube over-quotient obstruction; the general algebra is not kernel-checked.
normalized_hypotheses.rationale: The proposed u_i=X_i^3 construction quotients by C3^m rather than the diagonal C3 action and loses relative phase. The correct finite orbit offers only fixed-cardinality compression; no replacement complexity-changing mechanism is currently specified.
normalized_hypotheses.reopening_condition: A new candidate supplies a materially different exact mechanism, handles the fixed-target fiber explicitly, predicts a growth-relevant effect beyond orbit cardinality, and includes an independent raw-artifact validator.

normalized_hypotheses.verifier_scope: Toy-curve EDS torsion identities independently replayed with elliptic-curve arithmetic; no attack-advantage prediction was tested.
normalized_hypotheses.rationale: The bounded run supports the known torsion identity. It neither tests nor supplies a non-reencoding DLP mechanism, so the broader research hypothesis remains inconclusive and closed at intake.
normalized_hypotheses.reopening_condition: A proposal specifies a new operation on EDS data with a justified cost below finding the discrete logarithm directly.

route_axis_contract.rule: Threat-model scope, substrate decision disposition, and Engine evidence are independent axes.

trust_boundary.creative_output: A generated seed or proposer-authored mechanism is untrusted research input. It may be novel, mistaken, duplicated, or merely a renamed representation.
trust_boundary.deterministic_engine: The deterministic layer checks provenance, scope, exact required fields, known-premise fingerprints, review coverage, and authorization boundaries. It does not prove mathematical novelty or truth.
trust_boundary.quality_claim: Quality-cleared means that every declared hard gate and five-role review gate passed for the exact proposal digest. It does not mean the hypothesis is true, novel in all literature, or likely to break ECDLP.
trust_boundary.authorization_boundary: This layer never authorizes an experiment, promotes a route, targets secp256k1 directly, or makes an asymptotic claim.

typed_evidence.authorization_boundary: Typed cells and desk decisions authorize nothing. Only an open cell may seed an untrusted proposal, and every later experiment and promotion gate remains separate.

seed_coverage.rule: An overflow is materialized rather than hidden or treated as a generation failure. Every seed remains non-executable; the coverage artifact must be reviewed before a later cycle may change the threshold or synthesis partition.

typed_cell.construction: Find an auxiliary curve E0 over the same field whose order contains a B-smooth factor near p to the one-over-m scale; use the kernel self-isogeny on E0 to construct the composed root map L for target-curve factor-base coordinates.
typed_cell.relation_action: The original target curve remains the relation group. The auxiliary self-isogeny defines only the root set and low-degree decomposition of L; all recovered x-values must still lift to valid target-curve points and relations.
typed_cell.changed_quantity: Auxiliary-curve search, composed-map construction, generalized-root solving, recovery, and total relation-generation cost.

cost_quantity.label: Generalized root-finding and recovery cost
cost_quantity.definition: Cost of solving the composed-map fiber constraints and recovering valid factor-base points without hidden discarded components.
cost_quantity.baseline: Direct factor-base membership and relation recovery at the same arity and effective factor-base size.
cost_quantity.measurement: Price all roots, spurious fibers, recovery failures, preprocessing, and independent relation validation as field size grows.

requirement_results.rationale: The construction cannot proceed until an explicit auxiliary-curve instance over the shared field is constructed and its complete cost is recorded.

typed_cell.boundary: The first output is a bounded arithmetic construction or no-instance record plus a complete precomputation estimate, not an ECDLP experiment.

target_feature.statement: Petit-style factor bases define x-coordinates through a low-degree composition, creating structured fibers whose relation yield and generalized root-solving cost can be measured independently.
target_feature.boundary: A smaller coordinate image or a successful toy solve is not a complexity improvement unless recovery, exceptional fibers, preprocessing, and total relation cost are all included.

mechanism_primitive.statement: Exploit a composed rational map only through an algorithm that enumerates or samples valid fibers, recovers curve points, prices excluded components, and returns independently checkable relations.
mechanism_primitive.boundary: The construction remains a proposal primitive until its generalized root problem and all offline work are cheaper than the matched plain presentation at increasing toy sizes.

unresolved_question.statement: The faithful Petit-style route has no validated algorithm showing that generalized root finding plus recovery and preprocessing beats the matched plain factor-base pipeline as field size grows.
unresolved_question.boundary: Approximate or nonfaithful variants and isolated toy wins do not answer the faithful generalized-root question.

proposal_packet.instruction: Return a provenance-bound arithmetic construction, a scoped no-instance result, or the smallest exact blocker. Do not return an attack claim or experiment; unresolved conditions remain unknown.

typed_cell.construction: Use the available divisor 564522 of p-minus-one, which exceeds both the exact arity-sixteen raw threshold 65536 and balance threshold 445676, then price the complete map, relation system, and recovery path.
typed_cell.relation_action: The construction clears both arithmetic predicates only by moving to a high-arity Semaev relation. For nonsingular y^2=x^3+7 in characteristic not in {2,3,7}, TASK-017 fixes the exact set-theoretic projective S3-tree semantics, every named exceptional fiber, supplied-coordinate recovery, and GLV lift signs. TASK-018 freezes the recursive projective S17 contract with fixed degrees and the literal Sylvester determinant under the frozen coefficient, argument, and row order. TASK-019 kernel-checks the fixed-degree projective resultant common-root theorem, the literal TASK-018 Sylvester matrix and determinant with coefficient unit 1, and the end-to-end common-root corollary while retaining formal-degree drops, zero forms, affine witnesses, and [1:0]. The remaining exact mechanism gap is the recursive frozen C_r specialization at formal degrees (2^(r-2),2), including affine output and [1:0], plus the universal C16-to-C2 induction.
typed_cell.changed_quantity: Total construction, representation, solving, and recovery cost of the corresponding S17 system.

cost_quantity.label: Semaev S17 system construction and solving cost
cost_quantity.definition: Total cost of constructing, representing, solving, and validating the relation system required by an arity-sixteen smooth-subgroup instantiation.
cost_quantity.baseline: The same success probability priced against generic square-root work and lower-arity prime-field relation pipelines.
cost_quantity.measurement: An exact symbolic size bound must precede any solver run; degree, monomial count, memory, and recovery are all included.

requirement_results.rationale: The available divisor exceeds the exact condition-one ceiling of p to the one-sixteenth.
The available divisor also exceeds the source-anchored relation-yield balance ceiling of (16! times p) to the one-sixteenth.
